checks.proves: The diagnosis package remains structurally complete and internally linked.
checks.doesNotProve: Package validity does not prove product/runtime closure.
checks.passCriteria: Validator exits zero on the final package state.
checks.failCriteria: Any schema, coverage, backlink, placeholder or strict completeness error.

checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove live runtime/visual behavior.

checks.proves: The repository-approved full Identity/Workforce/DSH/WLT/provider-supporting runtime smoke passes on the candidate.
checks.doesNotProve: Smoke does not cover every operator workflow, visual state or external approval.
checks.passCriteria: Full runtime smoke exits zero with no required service unhealthy.

checks.command: Manual evidence: execute all applicable CONTROL-PANEL-SECTION-REGISTRY scenarios on the exact candidate, including RTL, keyboard/focus, screen-reader semantics, large text, loading/empty/error/forbidden/stale/conflict/unknown-result and dependency recovery.
checks.proves: Human-visible operator behavior and accessibility/recovery states match the final candidate.
checks.doesNotProve: Manual evidence cannot replace automated backend/database/security/finance checks.
checks.passCriteria: Evidence is recorded for every applicable section/hidden route with no unresolved blocker.
checks.failCriteria: Any applicable state/control/scenario is missing, misleading or inaccessible.

checks.command: Evidence review: bind required Product Truth product-owner, QA/device/accessibility, security/privacy, finance-control and release approvals to the exact candidate where each contract requires them.
checks.proves: Protected external acceptance requirements are present and SHA-bound.
checks.doesNotProve: This implementation package cannot grant those approvals itself.
checks.passCriteria: Every approval required for the claimed closure level is present for the exact candidate; otherwise the decision remains NEEDS_EVIDENCE.
checks.failCriteria: A protected required approval is missing, stale, self-granted or bound to another SHA while closure is claimed.
